nodes.description: Public mapping of token balances per address; mutated by transfer/transferFrom/batchSend/constructor with unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping of owner-to-spender allowances; written by approve and transferFrom.
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Constant decimals value (18) used for supply scaling.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Private privileged owner address set from msg.sender in the constructor and used as an access-control gate.
Hardcoded constant whitelisted router address checked in ensure().
Private per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition().
Private mapping whitelisting addresses allowed to sell without condition checks.
Private minimum sale amount set by init() and enforced in condition().
Private maximum sale amount set by init() and enforced in condition().
Private max number of sales per address set by init() and enforced in condition().
Owner-controlled trade address whitelisted in ensure() and set by setTradeAddress().
External caller address, attacker-controllable, used for authorization checks and as the from-account in token transfers.
Arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) in delegate() allowing arbitrary code execution in the contract context.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, which can overflow.
public payable transfer(_to,_value) that forwards msg.sender into transferFrom.
internal view ensure() whitelist gate comparing _from/_to against owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale.
public payable transferFrom(_from,_to,_value) performing allowance check, whitelist check and unchecked balance updates.
public payable approve(_spender,_value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
internal view condition() enforcing _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits via _onSaleNum.
Owner-only delegate() executing arbitrary calldata through delegatecall.
Owner-only init() that writes _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum sale configuration.
Owner-only batchSend() looping over _tos with unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance decrement.
Owner-only setTradeAddress() storing a whitelisted trade address.
internal pure pairFor() computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
payable constructor setting name/symbol/supply, owner=msg.sender and an infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
Recipient parameter _to of transfer().
Amount parameter _value of transferFrom().
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom().
Spender parameter _spender of approve().
Local variable total in batchSend computed as _value * _tos.length.
Recipient array parameter _tos of batchSend().
Target address parameter a of delegate().
Calldata parameter b of delegate().

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with _from and used to index/decrement allowance[msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance write in approve.
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), an authorization dependency on the caller.
init() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) before mutating sale configuration.
batchSend() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) before mass balance writes.
setTradeAddress() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) before storing the trade address.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and grants initial supply/allowance to the caller.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument into transferFrom.
transfer() invokes transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure() falls back to condition(_from,_value) when the whitelist check fails.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value susceptible to underflow.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
delegate() forwards attacker-supplied calldata to a.delegatecall(b) after only an owner check.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping for the non-owner spender path.
transfer ultimately mutates balances through transferFrom.
init() writes _minSale from the token argument.
init() writes _maxSale from the maxToken argument.
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum argument.
ensure() indirectly reads _onSaleNum via condition() to gate sellers.
condition() reads _minSale when validating _value.
condition() reads _maxSale when validating _value.
condition() reads _saleNum when validating _onSaleNum[_from].
condition() reads the per-address sale counter _onSaleNum.
setTradeAddress() stores addr into the tradeAddress state variable.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner state variable.
ensure() compares _from against the hardcoded UNI router constant.
ensure() compares _from against the mutable tradeAddress whitelist entry.
ensure() reads the canSale whitelist mapping for _from.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
Constructor assigns the owner state variable from msg.sender.
Constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants an unlimited allowance for msg.sender to the Uniswap router.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for the caller and each recipient.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender and _spender.
Parameter _to flows into transferFrom as the recipient argument.
Parameter _value flows into the arithmetic and allowlisted condition checks of transferFrom.
Parameter _from flows into ensure()/condition() whitelist and balance checks.
Parameter _spender flows into the allowance mapping key in approve.
Local total flows into the balanceOf[msg.sender] >= total check and subtraction.
Parameter _tos drives the batchSend loop and multiplication length.
Parameter a is the arbitrary delegatecall target in delegate.
Parameter b is the arbitrary delegatecall payload in delegate.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of the transfer entry point and has no independent core semantics.
_value only parameterises the value checks and unchecked balance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
_from only parameterises the whitelist and balance lookups inside transferFrom.
_spender is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
total is a transient local computing the unchecked multiplication inside batchSend.
_tos only drives the recipient loop of batchSend.
a is only the arbitrary target of the delegatecall inside delegate.
b is only the arbitrary calldata payload of the delegatecall inside delegate.
